hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Maintain a neutral, reduced-risk posture. Although the cross-asset regime is risk_on, the core signals are flat to modestly negative and conviction is weak. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are especially fragile: identical metrics, zero volatility, zero expected shortfall, and zero liquidity/institutional inputs strongly suggest missing or default data rather than reliable bullish evidence. LTC is also fragile due to weak conviction, negative composite/alpha, and poor liquidity. No symbol merits a constructive increase until the data quality issue is resolved.
